brief.runs: Test Desk: waiting on you {waiting}, with the AI {done}, processed {processed}{where}
ui.help_viewer: Previous / next preview, in the viewer
ui.help_esc: Leave a field, close a panel
ui.offline: Project Desk server not reachable. Is `{command} serve` still running?

common.problems.one: {n} file has problems. Run {command} validate to see them.
common.problems.other: {n} files have problems. Run {command} validate to see them.

dec.parked_title: The AI works with option {id} until you answer
dec.parked_line: Parked: the AI works with option {option} until you answer. A later answer can change work already done.
dec.empty_filter_text: Clear the filter to see everything.
dec.empty_inbox_text: New requests appear here as the AI raises them.

dec.empty_inbox_waiting.one: {n} answered decision is waiting on the AI.
dec.empty_inbox_waiting.other: {n} answered decisions are waiting on the AI.

dec.empty_waiting_text: Answers you save show up here until the AI applies them.
dec.empty_history_text: Resolved and withdrawn decisions stay here, with the AI's resolution.
dec.empty_all_text: They live in {dir}/ as Markdown files.
dec.badge_blocking: Decisions waiting on you: {n}, blocking work: {b}
dec.none_text: When the AI needs a call from you, it writes a request to {dir}/D-XXXX-*.md and it shows up here.
dec.none_by_hand: You can also answer by editing those files by hand.
dec.nothing_selected_text: Pick a decision on the left, or press <kbd>j</kbd> to start.
dec.asked_label: Waiting on the AI · you asked {when}
dec.asked_text: The AI answers under “Follow-up” in the context and sends this back to your inbox. You can still answer now.
dec.answered_text: Waiting for the AI to check and apply it. You can change your answer until then.
dec.other_text: None of these as written. Describe your own call in the comment, for example a mix of two options.
dec.comment_placeholder: Comment: your reasoning, a condition, or a question for the AI
dec.nothing_picked: Nothing picked yet. Press {keys}, or o for other.
dec.stale: This file changed on disk. <button type="button" data-action="reload">Reload it</button> (your comment is kept).
dec.err_question: Write your question in the comment first.
dec.err_pick: Pick an option first: {keys}, or o for other.
dec.err_other: Describe your “Other” answer in the comment.
dec.toast_asked: {id}: question saved, now waiting on the AI
dec.help_ask: Ask for more info (the comment is your question)
plan.decision.needs-info: you asked a question, the AI is answering
plan.decision.answered: answered, the AI is applying it
plan.decision_parked: parked: the AI works with the recommended option
plan.now_empty: Nothing is in progress right now.
plan.next_empty: The next step is not picked yet.
plan.from_you_empty: Nothing is needed from you right now.
plan.none_text: It shows up here when the AI creates {file}.

plan.problems.one: The plan file has an error. Run {validate} to see it.
plan.problems.other: The plan file has {n} errors. Run {validate} to see them.

qa.list_empty_text: The AI writes them in {dir}/ when there is something to check by hand.
qa.note_fail: What went wrong? Optional, but it helps a lot
qa.note_blocked: What stopped you from walking this case?
qa.done_text: The AI goes through every case that failed or was blocked and writes what it did about it. You can still change a result.
qa.processed_text: The AI went through this run. It is read-only now: the AI checks what failed in a new run.
qa.overall_placeholder: What stayed with you from the whole run: the most useful thing for the AI (optional)
qa.cases_hint: j/k between cases · p f b s to mark · c note
qa.none_text: When a change touches what a person sees, the AI writes a short run in {dir}/ and it shows up here.
qa.conflict: The run changed on disk; {what} was not saved. Do it again.
qa.err_unmark_done: The run is finished: pick another result instead of un-marking.
qa.toast_finished_bad: The AI will go through what failed.
qa.help_mark: Pass, fail, blocked, skip (again to un-mark)
qa.help_note: Write a note on the case
qa.help_save_note: Save the note, go to the next case
